title: 1 Kings Bible Quiz - Chapter 12
description: Ten questions on 1 Kings 12: Rehoboam's harsh answer, the split of the kingdom, and Jeroboam's golden calves at Bethel and Dan.

questions.text: Where had all Israel come to make Rehoboam king?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 12:1 says Rehoboam went to Shechem, for all Israel had come to Shechem to make him king.

questions.text: What did Jeroboam and the assembly of Israel ask Rehoboam to do?
questions.explanation: In 1 Kings 12:4 they ask him to make the hard service of his father and his heavy yoke lighter, and they will serve him.

answers.text: Make his father's heavy yoke lighter
Lower the taxes on their harvests
Move the capital back to Shechem
Send away his father's foreign wives

questions.text: How long did Rehoboam tell the people to go away before coming back?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 12:5 says he told them, "Depart for three days, then come back to me."

questions.text: What counsel did the old men who had stood before Solomon give Rehoboam?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 12:7 says they told him that if he would be a servant to this people and answer them with good words, they would be his servants forever.

answers.text: Gather an army and crush the rebels
Serve the people and answer them with good words
Ask the prophet Ahijah what to do

questions.text: The young men told Rehoboam to say his little finger was thicker than what?
questions.explanation: In 1 Kings 12:10 the young men tell him to say, "My little finger is thicker than my father's waist."

questions.text: Rehoboam said, "My father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with..." what?
questions.explanation: In 1 Kings 12:14 Rehoboam says, "My father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions."

questions.text: What happened to Adoram, who was over the men subject to forced labor?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 12:18 says King Rehoboam sent Adoram, and all Israel stoned him to death with stones.

answers.text: He fled to Egypt with Jeroboam
All Israel stoned him to death
He was made king over Israel

questions.text: What did the word of God through Shemaiah tell Rehoboam and his men?
questions.explanation: In 1 Kings 12:24 Yahweh says, "You shall not go up or fight against your brothers, the children of Israel. Everyone return to his house."

answers.text: Not to go up or fight against their brothers
To attack the house of Israel at once
To build a wall around Jerusalem
To make peace by giving up Jerusalem

questions.text: What did Jeroboam make so the people would not have to go up to Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 12:28 says the king took counsel and made two calves of gold, and told the people it was too much for them to go up to Jerusalem.

questions.text: Where did Jeroboam set up the golden calves?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 12:29 says he set the one in Bethel, and the other he put in Dan.
